description: Pyrosage: flame intelligence (pyro = fire, sage = wise one). In microgravity, fire behaves nothing like it does on Earth: no buoyancy, spherical flames, unpredictable spread. We're using AI on NASA's microgravity combustion data to predict how fires grow and die out, helping keep astronauts safe. Physics-minded Houston team seeking teammates in ML, data analysis, statistics, and web development. No combustion background needed, just curiosity. Message us to join!
summary:
Project Pyrosage is an interactive, Super Intelligence (SI)-powered fire safety platform developed for NASA's "Flame in Freefall" challenge. We built an intelligence dashboard that ingests, normalizes, and interprets all 24 microgravity combustion investigations (19 flight, 5 ground; 2,009 test runs) from NASA's Physical Science Informatics (PSI) repository.

Flames in microgravity lack buoyant convection, forming spherical diffusion flames that behave unpredictably in spacecraft environments. Pyrosage solves the difficulty of navigating this massive archive by structuring data across NASA's Spacecraft Fire Safety Triad: Prevention (BASS, Saffire), Detection (SAME, DAFT), and Suppression (FLEX). The platform enables researchers and engineers to dynamically evaluate fire risks across exploration profiles (including the hyperoxic Lunar Moon Base at 32% O2, Martian habitats, and EVA spacesuits), while extracting predictive flammability thresholds and terrestrial firefighting spin-offs.

By transforming decades of complex spaceflight data into actionable engineering constraints, Pyrosage makes the next giant leap safer for astronauts returning to the Moon and venturing to Mars.
details:
Project Pyrosage is an interactive fire safety intelligence dashboard that normalizes and analyzes all 24 NASA Physical Science Informatics (PSI) microgravity investigations (2,009 flight runs). It structures data across NASA's Fire Safety Triad: Prevention (BASS, Saffire), Detection (SAME, DAFT), and Suppression (FLEX). Users can evaluate fire risks across mission environments, including the Lunar Moon Base (32% O2), Martian habitats, ISS, and EVA spacesuits.

Benefits & Intended Impact
Microgravity flames lack natural buoyancy, forming spherical diffusion flames that burn unpredictably in hyperoxic atmospheres. Pyrosage provides aerospace engineers with empirical flight limits to select safe materials, calibrate detectors for non-buoyant smoke particles, and size gaseous suppression systems. It also highlights Earth-based spin-offs, such as fine-water-mist suppression systems and firefighter protective gear.

Tools & Technologies

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript (strict mode), Tailwind CSS, Vite.
  • Data & Verification: Python for PSI dataset ingestion, Zod for schema validation, Vitest for automated physics verification suites.

Creativity & Factors Considered
We transformed decades of raw, fragmented CSV flight records into an operational risk-scoring matrix. The platform explicitly accounts for the absence of buoyant convective cooling, life-support airflow velocities, spherical flame kinetics, and extreme flammability under exploration atmospheres.
